items.headline: FMRB executive-order S-407 classified threshold briefing
items.diff_narrative: Thursday sat in the T-minus-one window with the witness slate just locked at eight; Friday is the event itself. The S-407 classified session proceeds on schedule at 14:00 EDT and the unclassified press follow-on runs at 16:30 EDT, all eight witnesses testifying. The new development is the post-briefing record: Senate Cyber Subcommittee staff issue a Friday-evening unclassified summary memo confirming the briefing surfaced no objection to the per-state attorney-general consultation pathway or the AISI 120-day reciprocity placement window, and the subcommittee will circulate a classified-annex follow-up question set to the eight witnesses with a ten-business-day response request. The House parallel 30-day technical review window has moved from joint-resolution drafting to circulating draft text among subcommittee members for markup scheduling; OSTP holds the no-signing-before-May-22 line.

items.headline: Indo-Pacific cyber-evaluation reciprocity perimeter
items.diff_narrative: The cohort count steps from thirteen jurisdictions to fourteen. Thursday's Saudi Arabia adjacent-track pre-commitment converts Friday to a formal exploratory-observer entry with a 270-day national-consultation window, and Qatar's National Cyber Security Agency issues a fresh Friday adjacent-track interest note as the second GCC member to engage. The OECD GENAI working-group secretariat advances the attestation field schema from a draft Recommendation text scheduled for circulation to finalized text now formally circulating for member-state adoption, with the June 2-6 plenary still the operative target.

items.headline: Cerebras CBRS post-IPO consolidation
items.diff_narrative: Friday prints a fourth consecutive consolidation day after Thursday's third, closing the second trading week. The stock firms from a $197.10 Thursday close to a $198.60 Friday close on a tighter $196.30-$199.10 range, with turnover crossing $6.1B (up from $5.9B) and institutional-buyside net position ratcheting to 37 percent of float (from 35 percent). Bernstein's Friday week-close note holds the $185 Market-Perform floor and now describes the pattern as a structural second-week base that retires the single-event re-rating framing; Morgan Stanley lifts its $235 upside-scenario probability to 41 percent (from 38 percent) and UBS newly initiates coverage at Neutral with a $205 target.

items.headline: SEC Corp Fin AI-services-revenue sample comment letters
items.diff_narrative: Corp Fin posts a fourth sample comment letter Friday — addressing deferred-revenue recognition timing on multi-year hyperscaler minimum-commit contracts plus segment-disclosure granularity for AI-services-revenue-share pools — extending the May 8, May 13, and May 14 precedent set, paired with a staff observation note on rev-share-pool earnout disclosure. Tenstorrent advances from Thursday's first-round comment-letter acknowledgement at the 10-business-day mark to filing a substantive response at the 11-business-day mark. SambaNova's bookrunner roster holds at six and confirms the confidential-submission filing target to the final week of June; Groq's Saudi PIF contingent-secondary closure window narrows to 10-21 days.

items.headline: Mag-7 print-cycle Alphabet AI Services footnote positioning
items.diff_narrative: The Alphabet analyst day moves from T-minus-seven to T-minus-six calendar days as the week closes. The six-desk preview cohort lifts the Alphabet Q2 AI Services 10-Q footnote breakout probability from 84 percent to 87 percent, now citing both the four-consecutive-day Cerebras consolidation and the Friday Corp Fin fourth sample comment letter as material additions to the pricing-event set. Morgan Stanley Equity Research newly joins the cohort expecting Microsoft to ship the AI Services breakout in fiscal Q3 2026 alongside Meta and AWS.

items.headline: n8n CVE-2026-21858 (Ni8mare) exposure scan
items.diff_narrative: The day-fourteen scan rolls to day-fifteen with the May 21 federal-civilian remediation deadline now at T-minus-six business days. Internet-exposed pre-1.121.0 instances continue the taper from roughly 2,990 to 2,510 (-16.1 percent), with the residual unpatched long-tail share falling from 21 percent to 18 percent and Censys honeypot exploitation attempts easing from 2.4x to 1.9x baseline. The four-vendor C2 attribution baseline extends from nine frameworks to ten with Gh0st RAT added; the CISA federal-civilian operational directive incorporating the Trail of Bits taxonomy has now cleared the OMB publication queue and is scheduled for publication early the following week.

items.headline: MCP-server attack-surface defensive telemetry
items.diff_narrative: Cross-vendor agentic-AI control-plane visibility crosses the 90 percent threshold for the first time, rising from 87 percent to 91 percent of new MCP-server provisioning events as CrowdStrike Falcon for Agentic AI adds a Friday Azure AI Foundry Agent Service integration on top of Thursday's Amazon Bedrock integration — the first four-orchestrator managed-visibility composition. The unprotected-versus-protected credential-extraction gap widens further from 59x to 65x, Defender-for-Cloud quarantine on net-new MCP servers reaches 45 percent (from 42 percent), and Cisco-Astrix identity-gateway tenancy climbs to roughly 2,180 tenants (from 1,940).

items.headline: Haystack CVE-2026-45013 nested-dependency-resolver path traversal
items.diff_narrative: An eleventh agentic-AI tooling-stack CVE drops Friday, extending Thursday's ten-CVE Trail of Bits taxonomy. Haystack CVE-2026-45013 (CVSS 8.5) is a path-traversal flaw in the pipeline-component manifest fetcher's nested-dependency resolver, mirroring the AutoGen manifest-fetcher pattern but at the transitive nested-dependency resolution surface; the maintainer team ships v2.9.4 same-day plus v2.8.x/v2.7.x backports. Trail of Bits updates its taxonomy from ten to eleven CVEs and folds a nested-dependency-resolution canonicalization extension into the manifest-allowlist-validation tier, and the framework cohort's coordinated mid-June default-shipment commitment now covers five mitigation surfaces.

items.headline: Open-source serving stack release-candidate cadence
items.diff_narrative: The serving stacks advance one revision: vLLM moves from v0.11.4-rc1 to v0.11.4-rc2, SGLang RadixArk from v0.5.8 to v0.5.9, and Hugging Face TGI from v3.2.1 to v3.2.2, each adding the new nested-dependency-resolution canonicalization mitigation for the Friday Haystack CVE. The Yotta Labs benchmark throughput gap narrows further from 4.3 percent to 2.7 percent (the tightest of the cycle), and Cloudflare Infire holds L40S edge-tier latency at 1.00x parity ahead of the now-imminent Monday May 18 v0.11.4 stable release.

items.headline: Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 registry telemetry and Mythos-Preview gating
items.diff_narrative: Day-seven becomes day-eight with the second-week growth normalization continuing — published skills rise from 24,640 to 26,180 (+6.3 percent, a second consecutive sub-7-percent reading) and auto-quarantined Mythos-class skills go from 53 to 58. The Mythos-Preview gated cohort extends from 60 to 64 enterprise customers as Italy's Leonardo Electronics, Germany's Hensoldt Sensors, Norway's Kongsberg Defence Aerospace, and Finland's Patria Land Systems sign the ethics-and-misuse rider, pushing the rider's reach further across the Continental European and Nordic allied defense industrial base. The verification harness's cross-tenant compositional safety check improves from under 65 seconds to under 58 seconds via MIT-CSAIL parallel-verification optimizations.

items.headline: Mistral AI Workflows sovereign-cloud central-government adoption
items.diff_narrative: Day-fourteen rolls to day-fifteen and lands Belgium's FOD Financien / SPF Finances as the seventh central-government sovereign-cloud reference, after Portugal's Autoridade Tributaria on Thursday. Paid tenancy crosses 386 customers (from 367) and daily executions reach 6.9M (from 6.4M). The cross-orchestrator interop matrix expands from five vendors to six with Amazon Bedrock Agent Registry added, now targets general availability for the first week of June, and ships the mitigation set extended to the new nested-dependency-resolution canonicalization surface plus support for all fourteen Indo-Pacific cohort tenant-policy schemas.

items.headline: OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise per-org agent registry GA expansion
items.diff_narrative: The Indo-Pacific GA cohort extends from a six-region footprint to eight, adding Taiwan-cloud-region and Vietnam-cloud-region tenants on Azure, AWS Bedrock, and Google Cloud Vertex simultaneously, with the newly-added Taiwan National Institute of Cyber Security and Vietnam Authority of Information Security attestation fields cited. Codex CLI advances from v3.1.2 to v3.1.3, adding nested-dependency-resolution canonicalization for the Friday Haystack CVE. GA-cohort tenancy jumps from 257 to 341 enterprise customers by the Friday close.

items.headline: Tenstorrent Wormhole Galaxy rack shipment cadence
items.diff_narrative: The shipment wave steps from sixth-wave to seventh-wave, lifting cumulative racks deployed from 132 to 153 against the 280-rack first-half target. The standout shift is the second Latin American sovereign-cloud commitment: Brazil's Magalu Cloud joins Mercado Libre Cloud with a Brazilian National Cybersecurity Authority attestation framework. AMD's Helios plus MI450 commitment book grows from 9.7GW to 10.1GW following a 0.3GW Magalu Cloud commitment and a 0.1GW Saudi Arabia HUMAIN Cloud commitment under the new Gulf cyber-eval reciprocity exploratory-observer framework.

items.headline: AI-accelerator engineering-sample and production-rack cadence
items.diff_narrative: The sampling cadence advances a batch on each track. Cerebras CS-4 firms a fourth-batch engineering-sample window for late Q3 2026 (allocated to AI21 Labs, Reka AI, and Together AI) after Thursday's early-Q3 third-batch window; Nvidia ships fourth-batch Vera Rubin NVL576 samples to Mistral AI, xAI, and Microsoft Azure, extending Thursday's Anthropic/Apple/Lambda third batch; and AMD ships the first MI450 Helios production-rack samples to SoftBank Cloud Japan and SK Telecom Cloud Korea, extending Thursday's NTT Data and Naver Cloud Indo-Pacific allied tier.

items.headline: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Fremont production-line ramp
items.diff_narrative: A sixth cohort of 12 units brings the active count from 60 to 72 of the 240-unit allocation (30 percent reached), with cycle-time tightening from a 1.06x to a 1.04x human-baseline envelope. The coordination demonstration advances from Thursday's first cross-line (two-line) hand-off to the first three-line cross-cell coordination — twenty-eight units across the Fremont automotive, sub-assembly, and battery-module lines in a multi-station sealed parts-transfer chain. Volkswagen Wolfsburg's Optimus cohort confirms a June 22 first-activation date.

items.headline: Boston Dynamics Atlas commercial-roster milestones
items.diff_narrative: BMW Spartanburg advances from Thursday's first North American 24-hour continuous-operation milestone to the first North American 48-hour milestone with zero MTBF-impacting incidents. Volkswagen Wolfsburg's Atlas pilot scales further from 56 to 68 units. The fresh entry is Honda Motor Manufacturing Indiana confirming a 30-unit Atlas pilot for fiscal Q3 2026 on the Greensburg interior-trim task, adding the sixth OEM-adopted humanoid league-table customer. Hyundai Metaplant's Dangjin cycle-time improvement edges up within band from 5.0 percent to 5.1 percent.

items.headline: Verifiable cyber-evaluation reciprocity attestation-schema composition paper
items.diff_narrative: Alongside the expected nested-dependency-resolution canonicalization formal-verification paper (arxiv 2605.07041) extending Thursday's loader-verification wave, Friday adds a distinct companion paper: Verifiable Cyber-Evaluation Reciprocity Attestation-Schema Composition (arxiv 2605.07089). It extends the cross-jurisdiction reciprocity-attestation work to the now-finalized OECD GENAI attestation field schema, providing compositional safety theorems for the fourteen-jurisdiction Indo-Pacific cohort tenant-policy interop — the first research artifact directly pairing the loader-verification line with the multilateral reciprocity-schema track, jointly authored across the academic-and-policy reviewer cohort including the EU AI Office, OECD GENAI secretariat, Brennan Center, and Stanford CIS.
